posts.name: Doctor_Fate2000
posts.cooked: I am so sad to have gotten the Greater than Games update this mronign in regards to Vengeance.  I recently got turned onto Sentinels of the Multiveser right before the holidays and became obsessed.  I literally can NOT speak any more highly of this game to everyone I meet since I just fawn over it.  As soon as I got hooked I instantly ordered every single thing I could from the master game to all expansions to even things like extra tokens and as many of the promos as I could find outside of some of the earlier rediculous priced ones.  Had I discovered Sentinels of the Multiverse earlier, I would have instantly dropped the money to support Vengeance and been a part of the pre-order list, but now I searched everywhere (including even eBay) to see if I can order one and found right now it is impossible.  I wish there was some way to order myself a copy, but have run out of options and have to come to terms with that.  I am so sad to miss out on the first run of this set as well as those two promos but am happy for all of you who made the kickstarter/pre-order list and will get it in your hands in only a few weeks time.

posts.name: danmarshall14
posts.cooked:
You may not get the promos, but GtG is going to be shipping the Vengeance copies in this order: Kickstarter Backers, then Preorders, then Retailers/their own site.

I'm fairly confident you can expect to see Vengeance in stores and on the GtG Store by late February, once all the backers/preorders are sent.  So don't be so glum!  As for the promos, if you really want them, I'm sure some people will be selling them on eBay soon (if history is any indicator).  Some would rather make a small profit on the promo cards rather than keep them.
